title: The Seashell and the Clergyman - first surrealist film

commenti.body: I don’t think it wasn’t seen as a surreal movie because it was directed by a woman but because it was made in the period of French Impressionist cinema and was automatically put in that box. It uses a lot of the techniques that were common for impressionist cinema so it kinda checked that box before it checked the surreal one. An Andalusian Dog got additional buzz because it was co-directed by Salvador Dali.
